ABSORBING_BARRIER_BREACHED.description: Equity would fall below the absorbing-barrier floor; no new risk.

ADVISORY_CLAMPED.description: The advisory quantity exceeded the deterministic recommendation and was clamped to it.

ADVISORY_INVALID_OUTPUT.description: The advisory provider returned malformed or out-of-range output; treated as unavailable.

ADVISORY_REDUCE.description: The advisory recommended a smaller quantity than the deterministic engine; it was applied.

ADVISORY_REJECT.description: The advisory recommended rejection; it was applied.

ADVISORY_SKIPPED.description: The advisory was not invoked (disabled by policy or unnecessary after a hard rejection).

ADVISORY_UNAVAILABLE.description: The advisory provider was unavailable, timed out or raised; the deterministic verdict stands.

ADV_PARTICIPATION_EXCEEDED.description: The order would exceed the policy share of average daily volume.

AGENT_DAILY_NOTIONAL_EXCEEDED.description: The agent daily notional budget would be exceeded.

AGENT_DAILY_ORDERS_EXCEEDED.description: The agent daily order budget would be exceeded.

AGENT_OPEN_POSITIONS_EXCEEDED.description: The agent open-position budget would be exceeded.

AGENT_OUTSIDE_ACTIVE_HOURS.description: The proposal falls outside the agent active hours.

AGENT_STATE_MISSING.description: An agent budget is configured but the context carries no agent state.

AGENT_SYMBOL_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The symbol is outside the agent allowed list.

AGGREGATE_EXPOSURE_EXCEEDED.description: Post-trade aggregate exposure across agents would exceed the policy ratio of equity.

AGGREGATE_STATE_MISSING.description: An aggregate-exposure check is enabled but the context carries no aggregate state.

ASSET_NOT_TRADABLE.description: The broker reports the asset as not tradable.

ASSIGNMENT_RISK.description: A short leg carries early-assignment risk under the policy rules.

AUTHORIZATION_ALREADY_USED.description: The single-use execution authorization was already consumed.

AUTHORIZATION_INVALID.description: The authorization hash, idempotency key or structure is invalid.

AUTHORIZATION_NOT_YET_VALID.description: The execution authorization is not yet valid.

AUTHORIZATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH.description: The order does not match the authorization scope (symbol, legs, quantity or tenant).

BOOK_LIQUIDATION_TIME_EXCEEDED.description: Days needed to liquidate the book would exceed the policy maximum.

BROKER_UNAVAILABLE.description: The broker could not be reached; nothing was submitted.

BUYING_POWER_MISSING.description: The portfolio snapshot does not report buying power.

BUYING_POWER_UTILIZATION_EXCEEDED.description: Post-trade buying-power utilisation would exceed the policy ratio.

CALENDAR_MISSING.description: A time check is enabled but the context carries no calendar state.

CAPITAL_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED.description: Estimated notional exceeds the policy max_notional.

CHAIN_INTEGRITY_FAILED.description: The hash chain does not verify.

CHECK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.description: The policy enables a check the running engine does not implement; the policy is refused at load time.

CONCENTRATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Post-trade single-symbol exposure would exceed the policy ratio of equity.

CONFIDENCE_HAIRCUT_APPLIED.description: The agent-supplied confidence was reduced by the policy haircut before sizing.

CONSECUTIVE_LOSS_REVIEW.description: Consecutive losses reached the review threshold; no new risk until reviewed.

CORRELATED_INTENT_DETECTED.description: Too many agents proposed the same direction on the same symbol within the window.

CROWDING_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED.description: The crowding score exceeds the policy threshold.

DAYS_UNDER_WATER_EXCEEDED.description: Days under water exceeded the policy maximum; no new risk until reviewed.

DRAWDOWN_LIMIT_BREACHED.description: Portfolio drawdown from peak equity exceeds the policy limit; no new risk.

DTE_ABOVE_MAXIMUM.description: Days to expiry is above the policy maximum.

DTE_BELOW_MINIMUM.description: Days to expiry is below the policy minimum.

DUPLICATE_ORDER.description: An equivalent order was submitted within the duplicate window.

EARNINGS_BLACKOUT.description: The proposal falls inside the earnings blackout window.

ENGINE_DEGRADED.description: The engine is degraded; fail closed.

ENGINE_VERSION_MISMATCH.description: The engine version differs from the one that produced the record.

ERRONEOUS_PRICE_DEVIATION.description: The limit price deviates from the market price by more than the policy threshold.

ERRONEOUS_QUANTITY_DEVIATION.description: The quantity deviates from recent order sizes by more than the policy threshold.

ESTIMATED_IMPACT_EXCEEDED.description: Estimated market impact exceeds the policy maximum.

EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_EXCEEDED.description: Expected shortfall (99%) would exceed the policy limit.

FACTOR_EXPOSURE_EXCEEDED.description: Exposure to a factor (or beta) would exceed the policy limit.

GREEKS_MISSING.description: An option check requires greeks that the market snapshot does not carry.

HARD_REJECTION_UPHELD.description: The deterministic engine rejected; no advisory can overturn a hard rejection.

IDEMPOTENT_ORDER_EXISTS.description: An order with this idempotency key already exists at the broker; it was reconciled, not resubmitted.

INSUFFICIENT_BUYING_POWER.description: The proposal notional exceeds available buying power.

INVALIDATION_MISSING.description: The policy requires an invalidation level and the proposal has none.

INVALID_PRICE.description: A limit price is missing, non-positive or malformed.

INVALID_QUANTITY.description: A leg quantity is not a positive whole number of units.

KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE.description: The kill switch was active immediately before the broker mutation.

LEG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: The proposal has more legs than the policy allows.

LIQUIDITY_DATA_MISSING.description: A liquidity check is enabled but the market snapshot lacks ADV, spread or open-interest data.

LIVE_TRADING_FORBIDDEN.description: Only the paper environment exists; a non-paper configuration was refused.

MACRO_EVENT_BLACKOUT.description: The proposal falls inside a macro-event blackout window.

MARKET_CLOSED.description: The market is closed for this asset.

MARKET_DATA_MISSING.description: No market snapshot was available; unknown risk is not safe.

MARKET_DATA_STALE.description: The market snapshot is older than the policy tolerates.

MODEL_PROVIDER_CONCENTRATION_EXCEEDED.description: Exposure attributable to one model provider would exceed the policy ratio.

NAKED_SHORT_NOT_PERMITTED.description: A short option leg has no long leg of the same type covering it.

OPTIONS_DELTA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Projected portfolio delta would exceed the policy limit.

OPTIONS_GAMMA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Projected portfolio gamma would exceed the policy limit.

OPTIONS_SHORT_GAMMA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Projected short gamma would exceed the asymmetric policy limit.

OPTIONS_SHORT_VEGA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Projected short vega would exceed the asymmetric policy limit.

OPTIONS_VEGA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Projected portfolio vega would exceed the policy limit.

OPTION_OPEN_INTEREST_TOO_LOW.description: An option leg open interest is below the policy minimum.

OPTION_SPREAD_TOO_WIDE.description: An option leg bid-ask spread exceeds the policy maximum.

OVERNIGHT_EXPOSURE_EXCEEDED.description: Overnight exposure would exceed the policy ratio.

PATH_STATE_MISSING.description: A path-dependent check is enabled but the context carries no path state.

PIN_RISK.description: A strike is within the pin-risk buffer of the underlying price near expiry.

POLICY_HASH_MISMATCH.description: The policy hash in the risk context does not match the policy supplied to the engine.

POLICY_NOT_FOUND.description: No policy with the requested id/version/hash exists for this tenant.

PORTFOLIO_STATE_MISSING.description: No portfolio snapshot was available; unknown risk is not safe.

PORTFOLIO_STATE_STALE.description: The portfolio snapshot is older than the policy tolerates.

POSITION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Total quantity exceeds the policy max_quantity.

PRICE_MISSING.description: No price for the proposal symbol (or an option leg) in the market snapshot.

PROPOSAL_EXPIRED.description: The proposal expires_at is not after the engine evaluation time.

REAUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED.description: Fresh state supports less than the authorized quantity or a higher response level; a new authorization is required.

RECORD_NOT_FOUND.description: No record with that id exists for this tenant.

RESPONSE_LEVEL_ESCALATED.description: The tenant graduated-response level rose after the authorization was issued.

RESPONSE_LEVEL_HALT.description: The current response level halts all trading.

RESPONSE_LEVEL_RESTRICTS_NEW_RISK.description: The current response level does not allow new risk.

RESTRICTED_STRATEGY.description: The strategy is on the policy restricted list.

RESTRICTED_SYMBOL.description: The symbol is on the policy restricted list.

REWARD_RISK_BELOW_MINIMUM.description: The reward-to-risk ratio implied by the invalidation and target is below the policy minimum.

RISK_PER_TRADE_EXCEEDED.description: Risk to the invalidation level exceeds the policy share of equity.

SCHEMA_INVALID.description: The payload does not validate against its contract schema.

SECTOR_CONCENTRATION_EXCEEDED.description: Post-trade sector exposure would exceed the policy ratio of equity.

SECTOR_DATA_MISSING.description: Sector classification is missing for a symbol the sector check needs.

SESSION_WINDOW_RESTRICTED.description: The proposal falls outside the permitted session window.

SIGNAL_SOURCE_CONCENTRATION_EXCEEDED.description: Exposure attributable to one signal source would exceed the policy ratio.

SIZE_REDUCED_TO_POLICY_CAP.description: The authorized quantity was reduced to the binding policy cap.

SIZE_SCALED_BY_DRAWDOWN.description: Size was scaled down by the policy drawdown multiplier.

STATE_BINDING_MISMATCH.description: The state hashes bound into the authorization do not match the state the decision was made under.

STRESS_LOSS_EXCEEDED.description: Loss under the worst stress scenario would exceed the policy ratio of equity.

STRUCTURE_INVALID.description: The legs do not form the declared strategy.

TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED.description: The caller is not permitted to act for this tenant.

TENANT_MISMATCH.description: The policy, context and proposal do not belong to the same tenant.

TOCTOU_STATE_CHANGED.description: Risk-relevant state changed between authorization and execution.

UNDEFINED_RISK_REQUIRES_APPROVAL.description: An undefined-risk structure requires human approval, which the engine cannot grant.

UNKNOWN_FIELD.description: The payload carries a field the contract does not define.

UNSUPPORTED_ASSET_CLASS.description: The asset class is not supported by this engine.

UNSUPPORTED_STRATEGY.description: The strategy is not supported by this engine.
